T: Keep the curtains drawn. Keep the kettle on.
D: A mother and her two light-sensitive children live in a dark house on Jersey after the war.
P: Serve the tea when Mrs Mills brings in the tray.
S: a twisted doughnut from the island of Jersey
Dough of flour, butter, sugar and eggs rested an hour, rolled, cut into strips, slit and twisted, fried at 175C until golden, dusted with sugar.
Crustless sandwiches of cucumber and butter, and egg and cress, cut into neat triangles, served on a tray in the dark.
Crab meat folded with mayo, lemon, chives and a pinch of cayenne, piled on buttered toast.
M: Small new potatoes boiled with mint and tossed in salted butter, with pan-fried white fish, capers and brown butter.
Lamb mince with onion, carrot, tomato paste and Worcestershire, simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash, baked at 200C until golden.
W: Short grain rice baked slowly at 150C for 2 hours in full cream milk, cream, sugar and a vanilla bean, nutmeg grated on top.
K: always a pot of tea on the tray
English breakfast tea brewed 4 minutes in a warmed pot, milk and sugar on the tray.

s.note: a twisted doughnut from the island of Jersey
s.how: Rub 50g butter into 250g flour, add 50g sugar and 2 eggs and knead. Rest an hour, roll out, cut strips, slit and twist through. Fry at 175C until golden and dust with sugar and nutmeg.
Fold 250g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, chives and a pinch of cayenne. Toast 4 slices white bread, butter and cut into fingers. Pile the crab on top.

m.how: Boil 800g new potatoes with mint and toss in salted butter. Pan-fry 4 white fish fillets until golden. Brown 60g butter, add 1 tbsp capers and lemon juice, and spoon over the fish.

w.how: Put 100g short grain rice, 800ml milk, 200ml cream, 70g sugar and a split vanilla bean in a dish. Bake at 150C for 2 hours, stirring twice. Grate nutmeg on top. Serve warm, curtains drawn.

d.note: always a pot of tea on the tray
d.how: Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 tea bags and 1L freshly boiled water and brew 4 minutes. Serve on a tray with milk and sugar. Keep the curtains closed.
